# Custom Agents

This directory is a scaffold for future GitHub Copilot custom agent definitions.

## What belongs here

Custom agents extend Copilot's default behaviour with a specific persona, tool set, and instructions scoped to a well-defined role (e.g. a "code reviewer", a "migration assistant", or a "test generator").

## Status

Deferred — agent role design will be addressed in a dedicated session once the base template is stable.
